tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: Check one web page for AEO, SEO and performance: can a machine consume it? Returns the findings by check and the report link. If the exact page was scanned in the last 24 hours the stored result is returned at no cost; set fresh to scan again. A page that blocks our scanner is returned as blocked wi

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get a stored Bot Appétit report by scan id, the same report a person sees at botappetit.ai/r/<id>. Costs nothing and does not scan. Use it to re-read a report you were given a link to. A page that blocked our scanner is returned as blocked, with no score.

tools.name: page_history
tools.description: List every stored Bot Appétit scan of one exact page, newest first, with the score at the time and how it moved since the scan before. Costs nothing and does not scan. Use it to show whether a page has improved. Blocked and failed scans are listed without a score.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List every check Bot Appétit runs on a page, grouped by category, with the id of each. Use the id with explain_check for what a check means and what good looks like. Every check asks one question: can a machine consume this page?

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: Explain one Bot Appétit check: what it looks at, why it matters for machines reading a page, and what good looks like. Use the id from list_checks or a report. Costs nothing and does not scan.

tools.name: request_site_scan
tools.description: A whole-site scan reads a representative sample of a site and needs a person with a Bot Appétit account, and an agent never creates one. This returns exactly what the person must do, in order: connect this agent to their account (a one-time approval in their browser), after which start_site_scan, si

tools.name: leaderboard
tools.description: The highest-scoring sites by category, from the latest Bot Appétit scan of each site's homepage: rank, host, score out of 100, grade and a link to the full report. Call it with no category to see the top of every category, or with a category id for that board. Only sites that were scored on the curr

tools.name: start_site_scan
tools.description: Start a whole-site scan for the signed-in person's account: Bot Appétit reads a representative sample of the site (not every page) and scores it. Needs the person to have authorised this connection. It returns a job_id straight away and the scan runs in the background, so read it with site_scan_stat

tools.name: site_scan_status
tools.description: Read one of the signed-in person's site scans: whether it is still running, and once it has finished the score, the checks that failed, the category scores and the pages it covered, each page with a link to its own full report. Only the account that ran the scan can read it. A scan that is still run

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites the signed-in person follows in Bot Appétit, newest activity first, each with its latest site-scan score, the change since the scan before, and the trend. Use a host from here with site_history, set_pins and the other site tools.

tools.name: site_history
tools.description: Read one of the signed-in person's sites over time: every site scan of it newest first with the score and the change since the previous scored scan (a change across a scoring update or different pinned pages is marked, not passed off as the site's own), the pinned pages, and the monthly re-scan sett

tools.name: set_pins
tools.description: Pin or unpin pages on one of the signed-in person's sites. Pinned pages are scanned in every site scan of that site and count toward its score; up to 25, on the site itself. Give pin and/or unpin lists. Returns each address's outcome and the pins now in place; they apply from the next scan.

tools.name: set_rescan_settings
tools.description: Turn the signed-in person's monthly re-scans of their sites on or off, and the email of each result on or off. Leave a field out to keep it as it is; call with no fields to read the current settings. The settings belong to the account, not to one site.

tools.name: share_site_scan
tools.description: Create or stop the unlisted share link for one of the signed-in person's site scans. Site scans are private by default; a link lets anyone who holds it read that one scan (not the person's other scans) and stays valid until stopped. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_page, set_rescan_settings · Private data: start_site_scan, share_site_scan · Public sink: start_site_scan, set_rescan_settings, share_site_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_page, set_rescan_settings · Private data: start_site_scan, share_site_scan · Public sink: start_site_scan, set_rescan_settings, share_site_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "scan_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
